sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: An artist credit that ends with a join phrase after its last artist ("Bad Legs, SeekFlow,", "… feat."), usually left over from a removed artist, now shows in the ⚠️ WARNING menu and the 📊 Findings section of the Artist columns, with a yellow tint and the phrase in the cell's tooltip; the same list as MusicBrainz's report "Artist credits with dubious trailing join phrases". No requests. The tint has its own switch in ⚙️ Settings → ⚠️ Findings.
